title: Chapter 1400 - 14: The First Second Realm Method (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 1400 - 14: The First Second Realm Method (Part 2)

Chapter 1400: Chapter 14: The First Second Realm Method (Part 2)

"It’s too terrifying."

"Luckily, I’ve never confronted the Human Race."

"Who could have imagined Emperor Tianyuan would be a Red Dust Immortal?"

The supreme beings’ thoughts surged as they recalled how Emperor Tianyuan decisively swept everything away twenty thousand years ago, and they judged him as a Supreme being.

As for the Red Dust Immortal?

The Supreme being could to some extent compare with the Red Dust Immortal, but ultimately was not a Red Dust Immortal.

Even if some supreme beings speculated that Emperor Tianyuan might have reached the level of a Red Dust Immortal, that was mere speculation, never confirmed.

...

Outside Tianyuan Emperor Palace.

Diverse figures, numbering from dozens to hundreds, trapped in front of the Palace, also felt the terrifying surge when the celestial path was opened.

"Emperor Tianyuan... is already a Red Dust Immortal?"

The black-haired youth’s heart trembled inexplicably, first experiencing his inability to even step past the first of the thirty-three steps outside the Palace.

Now he discovered that Emperor Tianyuan, whom he regarded as a target, had already surpassed the Emperor level domain, causing his heart that finally calmed down to once again surge with emotions.

It’s not just the black-haired youth.

The other figures in the scene felt similarly.

These figures were quasi-emperors born in the past twenty thousand years, possessing either special physiques or powerful bloodlines, enough to rival ordinary supreme beings.

To them, the Great Emperor Realm was still something to look up to, with a hope of reaching.

But a Red Dust Immortal?

How many Great Emperors have been born throughout history, yet how many ultimately become Red Dust Immortals?

...

Lin Yuan withdrew his right hand, observing the twisting void that had been completely torn apart.

An irregular void passage appeared, connecting to a mysterious time and space, and that was the celestial path.

"I’m going in first."

Lin Yuan glanced at the entrance of the celestial path, sweeping his gaze over the many figures before the bronze Immortal Palace, stepped forward, and disappeared.

"Lord Tianyuan went in?"

The bronze Immortal Palace gently returned to its place, and the figures standing outside the palace showed inexplicable emotions.

Since Emperor Tianyuan revealed his true strength, over these twenty thousand years, he has left an indelible impression in the hearts of many figures.

...

Inside the celestial path entrance.

Invisible aura pervaded, where any trace of aura was enough to critically wound or even obliterate an Emperor-level expert.

"Is this the celestial path?"

Lin Yuan observed his surroundings, the space-time around him was incredibly stable, and the sweeping invisible aura turned calm upon approaching.

"This Great Destructive Force of the Origin World?"

Lin Yuan pondered silently, realizing that the invisible aura surrounding him at that moment was the Great Destructive Force.

This level of Great Destructive Force typically only appears in dimension spaces on the verge of the great annihilation.

At that time, under the sweep of annihilation aura, all creatures and spirits would be destroyed, even time lifeforms could only retreat from dimension space to evade it.

Forcibly remaining in the dimension space, time lifeforms wouldn’t endure it, as their bodies would collapse and be destroyed under the erosion of the Great Destructive Force.

"This Origin World hasn’t yet entered the great annihilation, yet it is already filled with such a level of great destructive force?"

Lin Yuan thought deeply, perhaps this was the special aspect deep within the celestial path? The goal that each time lifeform sought?

"Great Destructive Force..."

Lin Yuan observed the strands of Great Destructive Force.

His mind was continually filled with flashes of insight and comprehension.

[Your insight is extraordinary, observing the Great Destructive Force, your understanding of the Chaotic Origin Destruction Dao has improved]

...

[Your insight is extraordinary, observing the Great Destructive Force, you have grasped the Chaotic Origin Destruction Dao]

...

The Chaotic Origin Destruction Dao is one of the fundamental origin dao in the endless dimensional cosmos, much stronger than a single Chaotic Origin Taiyang and Taiyin.

This is an extremely fierce origin dao, influencing the destruction of dimension spaces.

Originally, Lin Yuan had an exceptional accumulation in the Chaotic Origin Destruction Dao, with the Chaos Void naturally leading to the universe’s great annihilation, thus also being a prototype of dimension space’s great annihilation.

After reaching the thirteenth stage to become a time lifeform, Lin Yuan increasingly felt the vastness of the Chaotic Origin Destruction Dao.

Now, entering the celestial path and experiencing the Great Destructive Force up close, the change in quantity led to a change in quality, making grasping the Chaotic Origin Destruction Dao naturally attainable.

The Chaotic Origin Destruction Dao belongs to the realization of the thirteenth stage Second Realm, akin to the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao.

Of course, the Chaotic Origin Destruction Dao inherently exists in the endless dimensional cosmos itself as an origin dao, while the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao is a self-origin dao developed by Lin Yuan.

This is why Lin Yuan grasped the Chaotic Origin Destruction Dao first, having the complete Great Destructive Force as a reference, compared to exploring in darkness and creating the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao from nothing, it was naturally much easier.

Yet, no matter how easy, it is a thirteenth stage Second Realm method.

"I didn’t expect entering the celestial path would have this benefit."

Lin Yuan’s face showed a smile, undoubtedly, the Chaotic Origin Destruction Dao is a thirteenth stage Second Realm method.

Grasping this origin dao, Lin Yuan’s strength again increased substantially.

"Is this considered the first Second Realm technique I’ve mastered?"

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Even before arriving at this Source World, Lin Yuan was able to rival a Thirteenth Stage Second Realm time lifeform.

But that kind of rivalry was entirely based on his own foundational accumulation, far exceeding the First Realm’s foundational accumulation.

As for techniques, he was still at the First Realm level.

"Let’s continue forward."

Lin Yuan didn’t stop, but headed deeper into the Immortal Path.

In the ancient times, various Immortal Kings and Red Dust Immortals who entered the Immortal Path should have already explored close to the end of the path.

This could be seen from the lingering traces around, left by the Red Dust Immortals and Immortal Kings of the distant past.

...

On the Immortal Path filled with the Great Destructive Force, ordinary time lifeforms would inevitably have their speed affected, needing to constantly resist the Great Destructive Force.

However, for Lin Yuan, who had already comprehended the Chaotic Origin Destruction Dao, the Great Destructive Force felt like water to a fish, not only having no impact, but even serving as an aid.

...

At the end of the Immortal Path.

Here it was misty, filled with strands of the Great Destructive Force.

In the distance, there was a new world entirely formed by an aura opposing the Great Destructive Force.

This world seemed illusory, evidently not fully developed yet; even so, the slight essence it emitted mesmerized the Red Dust Immortals.

However.

The closer one approached this illusory world, the more they would be swept by the Great Destructive Force. Even Immortal Kings could not stay too close for long.

"Marvelous, marvelous." A white-haired Immortal King was engrossed in observing that illusory world, with two other figures, also Immortal King level, sitting beside him.

"It’s a pity that entering that illusory world to comprehend would benefit us even more," the Immortal King on the left said quietly, his eyes full of longing.

"Enter? Even an Immortal Emperor can’t get in."

The Immortal King on the right shook his head. The illusory world was protected by the Origin Source of the Great Wilderness Origin World, and with the strength of its Origin Source, not even an Immortal Emperor would dare to confront it head-on.

"Hmm?" At that moment, the white-haired Immortal King suddenly noticed something and looked toward the beginning of the Immortal Path, "A Red Dust Immortal has entered."

Upon these words.

The other two Immortal Kings also looked.

Having been stationed on the Immortal Path for endless years, they were proficient in sensing changes in the aura of the Immortal Path.

Nothing could escape their notice.

"With the Great Destructive Aura permeating the Immortal Path, new Red Dust Immortals might not be well adapted. Should we send someone to escort them?"

The Immortal King on the left suggested.

The newly ascended Red Dust Immortals of the Great Wilderness Origin World were considered juniors to them, hence the three Immortal Kings valued them greatly.

"I’ll go pick them up."

A nearby Red Dust Immortal stepped forward.

Having been on the Immortal Path for so many years, he had long comprehended methods to resist the Great Destructive Force. He was much more composed than newly ascended Red Dust Immortals when facing the endless Great Destructive Force.

"Hmm....."

The white-haired Immortal King in the middle was about to nod.

Suddenly, his expression changed.

He stared toward the beginning of the Immortal Path.

The Immortal Kings on both sides also noticed something.

Their expressions turned incredulous.

"Immortal King, should I go now?"

The Red Dust Immortal who stepped forward was about to head to the initial point of the Immortal Path.

"No need."

The white-haired Immortal King paused for a few breaths and then shook his head.

"No need?"

The Red Dust Immortal who stepped forward was puzzled.

Not planning to escort that new Red Dust Immortal?

Were they expecting him to endure the endless Great Destructive Force on his own to get here?

Was it a test?

The Red Dust Immortal contemplated and guessed this might be the case.

"He has already arrived."

The white-haired Immortal King stood up, facing the initial direction of the Immortal Path.

"Arrived?"

The face of the Red Dust Immortal who stepped forward expressed shock.

The next moment.

Under the watchful eyes of numerous Red Dust Immortals and Immortal Kings.

From the beginning of the Immortal Path filled with endless Great Destructive Force, a figure approached, the Great Destructive Force that could grind down the flesh and body of a Red Dust Immortal appeared to intertwine and blend on the surface of this figure, unusually docile.
